paite: Himahleh Israel suante hamsiat thilte ah ahong talekta ua, Judah nam a Zerah tapa Zabdi, huai tapa Karmi, huai tapa Akan in hamsiat thilte ana la a, Israel suante tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
heading: Akan Khelhna

paite: Joshua in Jeriko a pan Bethel suahlam Beth-Aven chin a om Ai ah mi asawl a, akiang uah, "Va hohtou unla, gam va enkhia un," chi in agen hi. Mite ava hohtou ua, Ai khua ava enkhia uhi.

Joshua kiang ah akik nawn ua, akiang ah, "Mi tengteng hohtou chitchiat kei uhen. Mi sangnih hiam sangthum hiam va hohtou uhenla, Ai khua dou le uh. Mi tengteng va hihgim chitchiat ding ahi kei; tawmchik kia lah ahi ngal ua," achi uhi.
Huchi in mipi lak a mi sangthum huai ah ahohtou ua, Aite ma ah ahong taikek uhi.
heading: Israelte Vuallelhna

paite: Aite'n mi sawmthum-le-guk ana that ua; kulhbaang kongpi chin a pan Sebarim pha hial in adelh ua, akumsukna ah athat uhi. Huaiziak in mite lungtang azul khin a, tui bang ahong hita hi.
Joshua in apuante abotkek a, TOUPA bawm ma ah amah leh Israel upate amai ua lei si in nitaklam tan in abokkhup uhi. Alu uah leivui abuak uhi.

Joshua in, “Maizen! Toupa PATHIAN aw, bang ding in ahia, hiai mipite hihmanthat dia, Amorte khut a piak dia, Jordan lui na pi galkai mahmah? Jordan lui gal ah lungkimtak in om hiathiat zaw mai le ung!
TOUPA aw, hichi a melmate delh a Israelte ataikek mawk uh bang ka lohta dia oi?
Kanaante leh hiai gam a tengte'n aza ding ua, ahon um ding ua, lei a pan ka min uh hihmangthang ding ahita ve ua. Na min thupi bang na chihta dia le?" achi hi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Thou in, Bang achia bokkhup nilouh na hia?
heading: Joshua Pathian Dawnna

paite: Israelte'n thil ahihkhial ua; zuih dia ka piak ka thukhun ah atalek ua, hamsiat thilte ala ua, agu nalai ua, asim iim behlap ua, amau van lak mahmah ah asimsel uhi.
Huaiziak in ahi, Israel suante'n amelmate uh zou lou a, amelmate a pan ataikek uh. Hamsiat in a-omta ua ahi. Hamsiat a om pen na lak ua pan na hihmang keileh ka hon ompih nawn kei ding.

'Thou inla, mipite hihsiangthou photmai in'. Akiang uah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou un. TOUPA Israelte' Pathian in, Israelte aw, na lak uah hamsiat thil a-om a ahi. Na lak ua pan hamsiat thil na lakmang masiah uh na melmate uh na zou thei kei ding uh.

Zingchiang in achichi a, na hong kilat ding uh ahi. Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N huai chi a na mat pen anam anam a ahong kilat ding uh ahi. TOUPA'N huai nam a na mat pen a- inkuankuan ua ahong kilat nawn ding uh ahi. TOUPA'N huai inkuan a na mat pen amalmal a ahong kilat nawn ding ahi.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, kuapeuh hamsiat thil na la peuhmah, amah leh aneih tengteng mei a hal vek ding ahi. TOUPA thukhun atatleksan ziak leh Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuaitak ahih ziak in, achi," na chi ding hi.
Joshua zingkhang in athou a, Israelte achichi in ahong kilangsak a; Judah namte mat ahong hita uh.
heading: Khelhna Zonna Leh Akan Sihna

paite: Judah namte ahong kilangsak nawn a; Zerah namte ana man a; Zerahte inkuante amalmal in ahong kilang nawn ua; Zabdi mat ana hita.
A-inkuante amalmal in hong kilangsak nawn a; huchi in Judah chi a Zerah tapa Zabdi, huai tapa Karmi, huai tapa Akan mat ahong hita hi.
Joshua in Akan kiang ah, "Ka tapa, TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian thupina pia inla; akiang ah kipuang in. Na thilhih hon hilh in. Kei kiang ah iim ke'n," achi hi.
Akan in Joshua adawng a, akiang ah, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian tung ah thil ka na hihkhialta, hichibang in ahi ka na hih:

'Gallak lak a Babulon puan hoihtak leh dangka shekel zanih leh dangka-eng tang shekel sawmnga buk ka mu a, ka enlah lua a, ka lata mai hi. Ngai in, ka puanin sung a lei a selguk ahi a, dangka pen huai nuai ah a-om,'" achi hi.
Joshua in mite asawl a, puanin sung ah ava tai ua; ngai in, apuanin ah selguk ahi ngei a, anuai ah dangka ana om hi.
Puanin sung a kipan alakhia ua, Joshua leh Israel suan tengteng kiang ah ahon tawi ua; amau TOUPA ma ah akoih uhi.

Joshua leh Israel tengteng in Zerah tapa Akan dangka, puan, dangka-eng tang, atapate, atanute, abawngtal, asabiltungte, abelamte, apuanin leh aneih tengteng toh api ua; Akor Phaizang ah apaitouhpih uhi.
Joshua in, "Bangziak a hon hihmangbang na hia? TOUPA'N tuni in nang leng ahon hihmangbang ding hi,” achi hi. Huchi in Israel tengteng in suang in adeng ua; suang a aden khit un mei in ahal uhi.
Atung ah suang achiangvum ua, tuni tan in a-om lai hi. Huchi in TOUPA'N aheh petmahna akiheisan hi. Huaiziak in huai mun min tuni tan in Akor Phaizang achi lai uhi.
